## 📋 Description of Changes
Please include a summary of the change, related issue, and clinical/technical rationale.

## 🩺 Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue or clinical calculation drift)
- [ ] New feature (e.g., biomarker telemetry ingestion, intervention slider)
- [ ] Performance improvement (caching, query optimization)
- [ ] Documentation update

## ✅ Verification Checklist
- [ ] Local production builds pass (`npm run build` in `frontend` and `admin`)
- [ ] Backend syntax check passes (`node -c backend/server.js`)
- [ ] All unit tests pass
- [ ] No patient identifiable health information (PHI) included in commit
